aiAnalysis.rootCause: Time-of-Check to Time-of-Use (TOCTOU) race condition in InventoryService.checkout() without database row lock or transaction isolation.
observedEvidence: 2 concurrent HTTP requests dispatched simultaneously within a 19ms window.
Multiple worker threads read stock=1 before preceding transactions committed their deductions.
Inventory dropped below zero to -1, generating 2 confirmed orders from 1 stock units.
reproductionSteps: Observe simultaneous read validation without atomic locking.
Check final stock level in database (-1).

runs.defectSummary: Race Condition Detected: 2 orders succeeded for 1 available stock unit (Inventory underflow: final stock = -1)

events.title: User 1 Dispatches Checkout Request
events.details: Buyer 1 initiated POST /api/inventory/checkout with itemId: "item-99", quantity: 1

logs.message: HTTP POST /api/inventory/checkout received from client IP 192.168.1.101

events.title: User 2 Dispatches Concurrent Checkout Request
events.details: Buyer 2 initiated POST /api/inventory/checkout with itemId: "item-99", quantity: 1

logs.message: HTTP POST /api/inventory/checkout received from client IP 192.168.1.102

events.title: Thread 1 Reads Inventory State
events.details: SELECT stock FROM inventory WHERE item_id = "item-99" -> Result: 1. Condition (stock >= 1) EVALUATES TRUE.

logs.message: [Thread-1] DB query SELECT stock FROM items WHERE id="item-99" returned 1
[Thread-1] Validation passed: currentStock (1) >= requested (1)

events.title: Thread 2 Reads Stale Inventory (Dirty Read Hazard)
events.details: SELECT stock FROM inventory WHERE item_id = "item-99" -> Result: 1. Thread 1 has NOT yet committed its deduction! Condition (stock >= 1) EVALUATES TRUE.

logs.message: [Thread-2] DB query returned stock=1 without acquiring a lock (READ_COMMITTED gap)
[Thread-2] Validation passed: currentStock (1) >= requested (1)

events.title: Thread 1 Decrements Stock and Emits Order
events.details: UPDATE inventory SET stock = stock - 1 (1 - 1 = 0). Order #ORD-8801 confirmed.

logs.message: [Thread-1] UPDATE inventory SET stock = 0 WHERE id="item-99"
[Thread-1] Order ORD-8801 persisted to database. HTTP 200 returned.

events.title: CRITICAL DEFECT: Thread 2 Decrements Depleted Stock (Underflow)
events.details: Thread 2 executes UPDATE inventory SET stock = stock - 1 (0 - 1 = -1)! Stock drops to negative. Order #ORD-8802 confirmed.

logs.message: [Thread-2] Invariant violation! Stock reduced below zero: -1
[BugMirror Monitor] RACE CONDITION DETECTED! Oversold item "item-99" by 1 unit.

events.title: Assertion Failed: Inventory Invariant Violated
events.details: Assertion [stock >= 0 && successfulOrders <= initialStock] failed. Expected <= 1 orders, got 2. Expected stock >= 0, got -1.

logs.message: Test execution failed invariant test: NonNegativeInventoryConstraint

aiAnalysis.rootCause: Time-of-Check to Time-of-Use (TOCTOU) race condition in InventoryService.checkout() without database row lock or transaction isolation.
observedEvidence: Two concurrent HTTP POST requests arrived within 2.1ms of each other (req_u1_a9f24 and req_u2_c81d0).
Both Thread 1 and Thread 2 read stock=1 prior to any database write occurring.
Thread 2 committed an inventory decrement (0 - 1 = -1) after Thread 1 already purchased the final unit.
Database persisted a negative integer stock value (-1) and generated two successful order confirmations (ORD-8801, ORD-8802).
reproductionSteps: Send 2 simultaneous HTTP POST requests to /api/inventory/checkout with payload {"itemId": "item-99", "quantity": 1}.
Ensure request execution interleaves between the stock validation query and the update query.
Observe that both requests receive HTTP 200 OK and database stock drops to -1.
aiAnalysis.jiraMarkdown:
h2. [CRITICAL] Race Condition: Flash Sale Overselling on item-99
*Defect ID:* BM-2026-084
*Severity:* Critical (Financial & Fulfillment Impact)
*Preconditions:* Item stock = 1 unit
*Reproduction Steps:*
# Dispatch 2 concurrent POST requests to /api/inventory/checkout
# Observe both requests return 200 OK
*Expected Result:* Exactly 1 order succeeds (HTTP 200), 2nd order fails with HTTP 409 Conflict.
*Actual Result:* 2 orders created, stock dropped to -1.
